GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field 3 Wide (5L from lead). Held Ground midrace until pushed to hold ground @ 500m. Struggling Five Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Weakened in straight. Vetted - lame near fore & hind. # Pulled up lame.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after straightening, was steadied when disappointed for a run.  A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to be lame (2/5) in both the near-fore and near-hind. Cleared.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Not pushed early & raced 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide (1.5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & only held ground in last 200m. # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 4 lengths. 4th turn looking for run 1 length. got split 250 metres. ran on strongly # had the run
Jumped Ok took sit 3rd fence 3len 800m 3rd fence Straightened Up 3rd took split to Kept Going Ok # honest effort
slow out x 1 length . Settled Down 6th on rail 7 Lengths @ 1000m. off fence Straightening Up all Clear in Straight Kept Finding line, had last crack last two strides # found best form
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Near the 1400m was steadied after improving and becoming awkwardly placed close to heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd & raced 2nd Two Wide (3/4L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along =lead Four Wide on home turn. Pressured @ 300m & weakened Six Wide in straight. # On-pace/folded.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr stated his mount weakened down the straight and was unable to run out a strong 1600m on heavy track conditions. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 2 Lengths 800m, Hard Ridden getting off heels soon after Straightening Up , kept grinding away and although a long way off first two grabbed minor placing # grinding placing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 3 lengths. under pressure turn getting split 3 lengths. ran on well # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and made contact with another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok led early Took A Sit 1 length then 2 Lengths Leaders back home turn 2 Lengths Saved Ground Inside has to be careful 200m Outside horses laying in Not Knocked About very final stages # onpace/even

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing a half length, continually Checked off heels from 900m when pace slowed greatly, dropped back to 8 Lengths rail turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # Had excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1000m was checked severely to avoid the heels of a runner which shifted in when not clear. Near the 900m was continually checked to avoid the heels of a runner which excessively reduced the speed. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down Mid Field 7.5 Lengths Two Wide , improved but still Mid Field trailing 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked wider and Made Ground in straight. First-up, should be fitter next start and wants further. # ran on fairly late
